user.title: Hisense U7QF
user.description: Enter the television IP address. Models other than 50U7QF / 50A690FEVS require explicit experimental opt-in and are not verified.

data.experimental_model: Allow an unverified related U4 model

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered Hisense VIDAA TV
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} at {ip_address}?

auth.title: Enter TV PIN Code
auth.description: A 4-digit PIN code should now be displayed on your TV screen. Please enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Hisense TV
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant needs to pair with your Hisense TV ({ip_address}) again. Press Submit to display the PIN on your TV screen.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hisense VIDAA TV
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings or re-pair with your Hisense TV.

options.title: Add Hisense U7QF
options.description: The TV remote, picture modes, screen brightness, frame interpolation, local dimming and Game Mode will be added when reported by the television.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the TV.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid PIN code. Please try again.
error.certs_not_found: Certificate or private key file was not found at the specified path. Please check the file location and permissions.

abort.not_vidaa_tv: Discovered device is not a compatible Hisense VIDAA TV.
abort.unsupported_model: This model is not verified. For a related U4 model, start manual setup with experimental model support enabled.
abort.bundled_certificates_missing: Bundled app certificates are missing. Reinstall the integration.
abort.old_integration_active: Disable the old Hisense VIDAA entry for this television first. Do not delete it.

data.include_apps_in_sources: Include installed apps in the media player source list

data_description.assume_screen_state: Replace the two screen buttons with an assumed Audio Only switch. Its state follows commands, not TV feedback; it is unknown after reconnecting.

send_key.name: Send Key
send_key.description: Send a key press or sequence of key presses to the TV.

key.name: Key
key.description: Key code to send (e.g. KEY_POWER, KEY_HOME, KEY_VOLUMEUP).

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key press.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Delay in seconds between repeated key presses.

launch_app.name: Launch App
launch_app.description: Launch an application reported by this TV; custom URLs and deep links are not verified.

app.name: Application Name or URL
app.description: The app name or deep link URL. Optional when an application ID is supplied.

app_id.name: Application ID
app_id.description: Optional TV application ID to use instead of the ID from the app list.

app_name.name: Application Name Override
app_name.description: Optional application name to include in the launch request.

url.name: Launch URL
url.description: Optional URL or deep link to pass to the application.

set_picture_setting.name: Set Picture Setting
set_picture_setting.description: Change an approved U7QF user control; calibration and service fields are rejected.

menu_id.name: Menu ID
menu_id.description: Numeric menu ID (e.g. 91 for Picture Mode, 92 for Backlight, 93 for Brightness, 94 for Contrast).

menu_value.name: Menu Value
menu_value.description: Setting value or preset mode name.

get_remote_card.name: Generate TV remote card
get_remote_card.description: Returns native dashboard cards using registered entity IDs, even while disconnected. Paste the contents of card into a Manual card, or add cards.main, cards.picture and cards.keypad separately. Do not paste the entire response.

no_target_device.message: No matching Hisense VIDAA TV was found for the specified service call target.

not_connected.message: Cannot send command: TV is currently disconnected.

confirm.title: Verify Client Certificates
confirm.description: Once you have copied hisense.crt and hisense.key into /config/ssl or /ssl, submit this form to verify.

error.certificates_still_missing: Certificates are still missing. Please ensure hisense.crt and hisense.key exist.

confirm.title: Re-pair with Hisense TV
confirm.description:
Home Assistant can no longer authenticate with your Hisense TV ({ip_address}). The TV broker has rejected the stored access and refresh tokens (this usually happens after a firmware update or hard power-cycle).

Click **Submit** to start the pairing flow. Make sure your TV is powered **on** (not in standby) — a PIN code will appear on screen.
